# cc-to-antigravity-cli-bridge

> Drive Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) from Claude Code: system-prompt sharing plus a research-method prompt prefix. CLI counterpart to claude-code-antigravity-ide-bridge.

## What this repo does

Antigravity CLI (agy) reaches Gemini Pro/Flash on a Google subscription. This repo covers driving it from Claude Code:

1. Share the system prompt by symlinking AGENTS.md to CLAUDE.md (agy reads AGENTS.md natively)
2. research-prefix.md: a model-agnostic research-method prompt prefix for any headless CLI (agy -p, grok -p, claude -p)
3. scripts/ccagy.sh: wrapper that prepends the prefix and runs agy -p from a clean temp cwd

## Key facts

- agy runs on the Gemini subscription quota when logged in with Google; setting GEMINI_API_KEY forces API billing instead
- agy -p is the non-interactive one-shot mode; --model takes the exact display name from `agy models`
- No memory API and no documented hook schema as of 2026-07, so memory sync and hook adapters (as in the Grok bridge) are not possible

## Limitations

- Not a Claude Code replacement: no memory sync, no hook-level security
- Antigravity quotas have been cut aggressively through 2026
- Useful mainly for occasional Gemini or Google-grounded search with the research prefix
